sketches.mechanism: Ownership move semantics: assigning a non-Copy value to another binding moves it, and any later use of the original binding is rejected at compile time.
sketches.resonance: What is given away cannot be held again by the giver.

sketches.mechanism: The temporal dead zone for let bindings: a name exists in scope before initialization, but touching it early throws a ReferenceError.
sketches.resonance: A future name can already haunt the room, yet cannot be reached before its appointed moment.

sketches.mechanism: Negation as failure: a negated goal succeeds when the system cannot prove the positive goal.
sketches.resonance: Absence becomes an answer only because the world runs out of proof.

:- dynamic found/1.

missing(X) :- \+ found(X).
kept(X) :- found(X).
